name: AMD Radeon Instinct MI50 datasheet (archived 2021-01-12)
notes: Archived AMD MI50 datasheet PDF (live URL now redirects to the docs hub). Spec table: 60 CUs / 3,840 SPs, up to 26.5 TFLOPS FP16, 13.3 TFLOPS FP32, 6.6 TFLOPS FP64, 53.6 TOPS INT8, 16GB or 32GB HBM2, 4096-bit, 1 GHz memory clock, up to 1 TB/s, 300W, 2 Infinity Fabric Links for 184 GB/s aggregate P2P.
